claims.text: The four CQA models were selected based on their different model architectures and training strategies.
The selected models include BERT, GraphFlow, HAM, and ExCorD, each with unique approaches to handling conversational QA tasks.

BERT serves as a baseline model that concatenates previous turns, while GraphFlow uses a recurrent graph neural network, HAM employs a history attention mechanism, and ExCorD focuses on question rewriting.
